items.title: 〈焦點股〉敬鵬獲工控新訂單挹注營收 股價順勢大漲攻漲停鎖死54.5元
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Jingpeng Boosted by New Industrial Control Order, Shares Surge to Upper Limit at NT$54.5
paras: 敬鵬(2355-TW)獲工控電子板新訂單挹注，9月營收攀升至18.71億元，也改寫102個月新高，激勵今(28)日股價早盤量能充沛並順勢大漲9.99%，攻漲停價54.5元。法人看好，敬鵬2026年整體營運可望較去年回升，隨著泰國新廠產能陸續加入，加上公司多年深耕泰國PCB市場、累積成熟的生產經驗，敬鵬在2027年成長動能也備受關注。
在全球車廠需求維持穩定下，敬鵬2026年上半年營收達97.7億元，年增6.17%，其中汽車板出貨占比升至77%，高於2025年平均的75%；此外，包含航太、低軌衛星(LEO)板等應用的網通板，出貨占比也維持在約5%。法人預期，隨著汽車板需求穩健，加上泰國新產能挹注，敬鵬2026年營運可望優於去年，2027年成長表現更值得期待。
汽車板市場需求回溫有利敬鵬營收、敬鵬並跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板在今年取得新訂單，業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
paras_en: Jingpeng (2355-TW) received a new order for industrial control electronic boards, lifting September revenue to NT$1.871 billion—a 102‑month high. The news spurred strong early‑session buying, pushing the stock up 9.99% to the daily limit price of NT$54.5. Institutional investors are optimistic, expecting Jingpeng’s overall 2026 operations to improve over last year. With capacity from a new Thai plant coming online and the company’s long‑standing foothold and mature production experience in Thailand’s PCB market, Jingpeng’s growth momentum in 2027 is also drawing attention.

Jingpeng’s September 2026 revenue reached NT$1.871 billion, up 27.36% month‑over‑month and 44.28% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue was NT$4.812 billion, up 13.45% sequentially and 24.7% annually; cumulative revenue for January‑September this year totaled NT$13.108 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 11.19%.

With global automakers maintaining stable demand, Jingpeng’s first‑half‑2026 revenue hit NT$9.77 billion, a 6.17% year‑over‑year rise, of which automotive board shipments accounted for 77%, higher than the 75% average in 2025. Additionally, network‑communication boards for aerospace, low‑Earth‑orbit (LEO) satellite and other applications remained at about 5% of shipments. Institutions expect that solid automotive board demand, combined with new capacity in Thailand, will enable Jingpeng’s 2026 performance to surpass last year, and its 2027 growth outlook looks even more promising.

The rebound in automotive board demand benefits Jingpeng’s revenue, and its foray into industrial control electronic boards is gaining traction. New orders for industrial electronic control boards were secured this year, with earnings expected to rise from the second half onward. Moreover, beyond completing the renovation and commissioning of its original Thai production base, the construction of a new manufacturing building is progressing smoothly, with additional capacity slated to come online in 2027. The company is also addressing rising CCL costs, which have been causing operational disruptions, by communicating the issue to its customers.

items.title: 與輝達合作還不夠！甲骨文擴張AI算力版圖  首納谷歌TPU、Cerebras推理晶片
items.title_en: Partnering with Nvidia Isn't Enough! Oracle Expands AI Compute Footprint, First to Add Google TPU and Cerebras Inference Chips
paras: 甲骨文週二(27日)宣布，將擴大與輝達的雲端AI合作，同時推進供應來源多元化，首度在自有雲平台引入谷歌TPU，以及Cerebras、SambaNova等競爭產品晶片，降低對單一供應商的依賴。
根據雙方聲明，甲骨文雲基礎設施(OCI)將大規模部署輝達新一代Vera Rubin AI伺服器，規模達「數個GW」。此前輝達執行長黃仁勳曾指出，Vera Rubin系統每GW部署可為輝達帶來最高400億美元收入，但本次交易金額未披露。
除算力採購外，甲骨文同步推動網通自主化：即便基於輝達芯片的系統，也將棄用部分輝達網路晶片，轉而採用甲骨文自研的Acceleron網路晶片。
在多元化佈局上，甲骨文將成為谷歌以外首家提供TPU的超大规模雲端服務商。OCI上的谷歌第八代TPU(含訓練型8t、推理型8i)預計2027年上線，逐年擴大規模，支援大模型訓練、推理與智能體應用。
此外，OCI平台也將納入英特爾支持的SambaNova與專攻推理的Cerebras晶片。
OCI總裁蒂亞加拉詹（Mahesh Thiagarajan）表示，不同AI工作負載對算力需求各異，開放多元選擇可讓客戶依性能、吞吐量與成本效益靈活配置。Cerebras執行長費爾德曼則稱，此合作將「大幅擴大其一級客戶群」。
目前英偉達主導AI訓練市場，但推理端競爭更趨多元，正為替代架構打開空間。市場聚焦甲骨文本週投資者日，公司維持2027財年資本支出約900億至950億美元目標，並稱愈來愈多客戶將自行承擔芯片採購費用，緩解現金流壓力。
paras_en: Oracle announced on Tuesday (the 27th) that it will expand its cloud AI partnership with Nvidia while diversifying its supply sources, introducing Google TPUs and competing chips from Cerebras and SambaNova on its own cloud platform for the first time, reducing reliance on a single vendor.

According to the joint statement, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) will deploy Nvidia's next‑generation Vera Rubin AI servers at massive scale, amounting to “several gigawatts.” Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang previously noted that each gigawatt of Vera Rubin deployment could generate up to $40 billion in revenue for Nvidia, though the transaction amount was not disclosed.

Beyond compute procurement, Oracle is also advancing network‑chip autonomy: even systems based on Nvidia chips will discard some Nvidia networking chips in favor of Oracle’s self‑developed Acceleron network chip.

With this diversification, Oracle will become the first hyperscale cloud provider besides Google to offer TPUs. Google’s 8th‑generation TPU (including training‑oriented 8t and inference‑oriented 8i) on OCI is expected to go live in 2027, with capacity expanding annually to support large‑model training, inference and intelligent‑agent applications.
In addition, the OCI platform will incorporate Intel‑backed SambaNova and inference‑focused Cerebras chips.

OCI President Mahesh Thiagarajan said different AI workloads have varying compute requirements, and offering a variety of choices allows customers to flexibly configure based on performance, throughput and cost‑effectiveness. Cerebras CEO Feldman said the collaboration will “significantly expand its Tier‑1 customer base.”

Nvidia currently dominates the AI training market, but the inference side is becoming more diverse, opening space for alternative architectures. Market attention is on Oracle’s upcoming investor day; the company maintains its FY2027 capital‑expenditure target of $90‑95 billion and notes that more customers will self‑pay for chip purchases, easing cash‑flow pressure.

items.title: 以色列國會大選 出口民調：尼坦雅胡陣營未獲過半席次
items.title_en: Israeli Parliamentary Election Exit Poll: Netanyahu Camp Falls Short of Majority
paras: 以色列第26屆國會選舉投票在27日（周二）晚間10時正式結束，國會選舉出口民調數據顯示，總理尼坦雅胡陣營未獲國會過半席次。
多家以色列媒體公布的出口民調數據表明，尼坦雅胡領導的執政陣營與反對黨陣營選情極其膠著。多數民調顯示，雖然利庫德集團仍為國會最大黨，但是與排名第二的反對黨正直黨差距不大，且兩大陣營均未能取得國會過半席次。
以色列第13頻道電視台出口民調顯示，尼坦雅胡領導的利庫德集團預估獲25席，埃森科特領導的中間派政黨正直黨獲23席，分別位列第一和第二。前總理納夫塔利·貝內特領導的反對黨團結黨預計獲14席，位居第三。
從陣營劃分來看，埃森科特領導的反尼坦雅胡陣營預估獲53席，尼坦雅胡領導的右翼宗教政黨陣營獲50席，雙方均未達到組建多數派政府61席門檻。
以色列中央選舉委員會公布的數據顯示，截至晚間10點，當天以色列國會選舉的選民投票率達到77.7%，超過2022年選舉同一時間點的70.6%，創下1999年以來同一時間點最高紀錄。
此次創紀錄投票熱情出現在以色列社會高度分裂的背景下。2022年國會選舉後，尼坦雅胡重新執政，並與宗教右翼及極端正統派政黨組成聯合政府。
2023年10月7日，哈瑪斯發動襲擊後，以色列接連捲入加薩、黎巴嫩和伊朗等方向的軍事衝突，國家安全、戰爭責任、兵役制度以及政府施政方式等問題，成為本次選舉主要爭論焦點。
根據以色列選舉法，政黨必須跨過3.25%得票門檻方可進入國會，並按比例分配120個席次。初步計票結果預定28日或29日公布，最終結果由中央選舉委員會於11月4日正式公布。
國會選舉結果公布後，各政黨將圍繞組建執政聯盟展開談判。以色列歷史上從未有單一政黨獨自贏得國會多數席次，選後組建聯合政府是常態。內塔尼亞胡能否爭取至少61個議席支持，是他能否繼續執政的關鍵。
paras_en: The vote for Israel's 26th Knesset election officially closed at 10 p.m. on Tuesday the 27th, and exit poll data shows that Prime Minister Netanyahu's camp did not secure a majority of seats in the Knesset.

Exit poll figures released by several Israeli media outlets indicate that the race between Netanyahu's governing coalition and the opposition is extremely tight. Most polls show that while the Likud group remains the largest party in the Knesset, its margin over the second-place opposition party, the Zionist Union, is narrow, and neither major bloc has achieved a majority of seats.

According to an exit poll from Channel 13, Netanyahu's Likud group is projected to win 25 seats, while the centrist Zionist Union led by Yair Lapid is expected to secure 23 seats, placing them first and second respectively. Former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett's opposition Union Party is projected to obtain 14 seats, ranking third.

From a coalition perspective, Lapid's anti-Netanyahu coalition is estimated to win 53 seats, while Netanyahu's right‑wing religious coalition is projected to secure 50 seats, with neither side reaching the 61‑seat threshold needed to form a majority government.

Data from the Israeli Central Elections Committee shows that by 10 p.m. the voter turnout for the Knesset election reached 77.7%, surpassing the 70.6% recorded at the same time in the 2022 election and setting the highest turnout at that time since 1999.

This record turnout occurred against a backdrop of deep societal division in Israel. After the 2022 election, Netanyahu returned to power and formed a coalition with the religious right and hard‑right orthodox parties.

Following Hamas's attack on October 7, 2023, Israel became embroiled in military conflicts with Gaza, Lebanon, and Iran, making national security, war responsibility, conscription, and government policy the main issues of debate in this election.

Under Israeli election law, parties must cross a 3.25% vote threshold to enter the Knesset, and seats are allocated proportionally among the 120 seats. Preliminary results are expected to be announced on the 28th or 29th, with the final results to be officially released by the Central Elections Committee on November 4th.

After the election results are announced, parties will negotiate to form a governing coalition. Historically, no single party has ever won a majority in the Knesset, and coalition governments are the norm. Whether Netanyahu can secure at least 61 seats of support will determine whether he can continue to govern.

items.title: Cerebras盤中漲逾10%！甲骨文首度引進其AI晶片 輝達合作擴至多吉瓦級
items.title_en: Cerebras Surges Over 10% Intraday as Oracle First Adds Its AI Chip; NVIDIA Partnership Expands to Multi‑Gigawatt Scale
paras: Cerebras股價受惠新合作消息走強，盤中一度大漲逾10%。甲骨文 (Oracle) (ORCL-US)宣布擴大AI晶片供應布局，首次將Cerebras Systems (Cerebras Systems) (CBRS-US)的AI推論晶片納入雲端服務，同時引進Google的張量處理器(TPU)，並將與輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)的AI基礎設施合作擴大至「多吉瓦級」規模，採用最新一代Vera Rubin AI伺服器。這一系列合作顯示，隨著AI推論需求快速成長，雲端業者正加速擴充晶片選擇，降低對單一供應商的依賴。
甲骨文聯席執行長克萊·馬古伊爾克(Clay Magouyrk)於10月27日在年度客戶大會上宣布，Cerebras系統預計於2027年上半年正式導入甲骨文雲端基礎設施(Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, OCI)。這項合作將讓AI研究機構、企業及開發者能透過OCI使用Cerebras的高速推論服務，支援互動式AI應用及AI代理等工作負載。

Cerebras的核心技術是晶圓級引擎(Wafer-Scale Engine)，將運算與記憶體整合在單一大型晶圓級處理器上，藉此減少資料傳輸及晶片間通訊的延遲。相較於傳統將晶圓切割成多顆處理器的設計，Cerebras主打更快的推論速度，尤其適用於需要多次呼叫模型、逐步推理及執行任務的AI代理。公司執行長安德魯·費爾德曼(Andrew Feldman)表示，與甲骨文合作將擴大公司接觸大型企業客戶的機會，也代表Cerebras的技術將以大規模方式部署於其他企業的資料中心。
除了Cerebras，甲骨文也宣布首次在雲端平台提供Google的TPU晶片，並將提供英特爾 (Intel) (INTC-US)支持的SambaNova Systems推論晶片。甲骨文雲端基礎設施總裁馬赫什·蒂亞加拉詹(Mahesh Thiagarajan)指出，不同AI工作負載對運算能力的需求各異，讓客戶依照效能、吞吐量及經濟效益選擇適合的基礎設施，有助於提升資源運用效率。
這項策略也反映AI晶片市場的競爭正逐漸分化。輝達目前仍在AI訓練晶片市場占據主導地位，但推論市場的競爭者更多，Cerebras及SambaNova等業者正試圖以更快的回應速度及不同的晶片架構爭取客戶。隨著AI模型被廣泛應用於聊天機器人、企業軟體及AI代理，推論運算需求持續增加，雲端服務商也需要提供多種硬體選項，以配合不同任務的效能與成本要求。
不過，輝達仍擁有龐大的市場規模與供應優勢。相關報導指出，輝達每季AI晶片銷售額已接近1,000億美元，遠高於新興推論晶片供應商的營收規模。對Cerebras而言，獲得甲骨文這類大型雲端業者採用，是擴大商業化的重要一步，但能否持續取得大型客戶、擴張產能並轉化為穩定營收，仍有待觀察。
根據彭博彙整的分析師平均預估，Cerebras明年營收有望達到約30億美元，約為今年預估營收的3倍；今年全年營收預計仍低於10億美元。消息公布後，Cerebras股價盤中一度上漲逾10%。不過，截至10月26日收盤，該公司自今年5月上市以來的股價累計跌幅仍約41%，顯示市場對其成長前景、估值及商業化進度仍存在疑慮。
另一方面，甲骨文與輝達的合作也進一步擴大。雙方宣布，將透過輝達最新一代Vera Rubin伺服器，把甲骨文雲端基礎設施的部署規模提升至「多吉瓦級」。雙方並未公布這項合作的具體金額，但輝達執行長黃仁勳曾表示，Vera Rubin系統每吉瓦的部署規模，可能為輝達帶來最高400億美元營收。這是對輝達潛在營收的估算，並不代表甲骨文此次合作的實際合約金額。
甲骨文也計畫在部分採用輝達晶片的系統中，使用自家Acceleron網路晶片，取代輝達部分網路產品，顯示公司除了增加晶片供應商，也希望在資料中心網路架構上提升自主性。甲骨文表示，擴大後的基礎設施將支援AI模型訓練、推論及AI代理應用，讓客戶依照不同工作負載調整中央處理器(CPU)與圖形處理器(GPU)資源。
不過，大規模擴建資料中心也帶來沉重的資本支出及融資壓力。甲骨文先前在財報電話會議中表示，客戶愈來愈常自行負擔晶片採購成本，並維持2027財年約900億至950億美元的資本支出目標。市場仍關注甲骨文如何為資料中心擴張籌資，以及新增投資能否及時轉化為營收與現金流。
整體而言，甲骨文此次同時擴大與輝達的合作、引進Google TPU及Cerebras推論晶片，並非單純轉向輝達的競爭對手，而是希望為不同AI工作負載提供更具彈性的運算架構。對Cerebras來說，甲骨文合作有望帶來大型雲端客戶與營收成長機會；對整個AI基礎設施產業而言，這也顯示競爭焦點正從單一晶片效能，延伸至推論速度、成本效益、供應能力及資料中心整體部署規模。
paras_en: Cerebras shares rallied on the news of new collaborations, spiking more than 10% intraday. Oracle (ORCL-US) announced it is expanding its AI chip supply strategy by incorporating Cerebras Systems' (CBRS-US) AI inference chip into its cloud services for the first time, also adding Google’s Tensor Processing Units (TPU), and scaling its AI infrastructure partnership with NVIDIA (NVDA-US) to a “multi‑gigawatt” level using the next‑generation Vera Rubin AI servers. This suite of deals shows that, as AI inference demand accelerates, cloud providers are rapidly broadening their chip portfolios to reduce reliance on any single supplier.

Oracle co‑CEO Clay Magouyrk disclosed at the annual customer conference on Oct. 27 that Cerebras is slated to be integrated into Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in the first half of 2027. The partnership will let AI research institutes, enterprises and developers access Cerebras’s high‑speed inference services via OCI, supporting interactive AI applications and AI agents among other workloads.

Cerebras’s core technology is its Wafer‑Scale Engine, which integrates compute and memory on a single, large wafer‑scale processor, cutting data movement and inter‑chip communication latency. Unlike traditional designs that dice a wafer into many smaller chips, Cerebras touts faster inference, especially for workloads that repeatedly call models, perform step‑by‑step reasoning, or run AI agents. CEO Andrew Feldman said the Oracle tie‑up will broaden the company’s reach to large‑enterprise customers and demonstrates that Cerebras’s technology can be deployed at scale in other corporate data centers.

In addition to Cerebras, Oracle also announced it will offer Google’s TPU chips on its cloud platform for the first time and will provide inference chips from SambaNova Systems backed by Intel (INTC-US). Mahesh Thiagarajan, president of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, noted that different AI workloads have varying compute needs, and giving customers the ability to choose infrastructure based on performance, throughput and economics improves resource efficiency.

The strategy reflects a growing segmentation in the AI‑chip market. NVIDIA still dominates AI training chips, but the inference market is more contested, with players like Cerebras and SambaNova vying for customers through faster response times and alternative architectures. As AI models proliferate in chatbots, enterprise software and AI agents, inference demand keeps rising, prompting cloud providers to offer a broader hardware mix to meet diverse performance‑and‑cost requirements.

Nevertheless, NVIDIA retains a massive market scale and supply advantage. Reports indicate NVIDIA’s quarterly AI‑chip sales approach $100 billion, far outpacing the revenues of emerging inference‑chip vendors. For Cerebras, winning a major cloud customer like Oracle is a key step toward commercialization, yet whether it can continuously secure large clients, scale production and translate that into stable revenue remains to be seen.

According to Bloomberg‑aggregated analyst estimates, Cerebras could generate roughly $3 billion in revenue next year—about three times its current‑year forecast—while this year’s full‑year revenue is still projected below $1 billion. After the announcement, Cerebras’s stock rose more than 10% intraday. However, as of the Oct. 26 close, the stock has fallen about 41% since its May IPO, indicating lingering market doubts about its growth outlook, valuation and commercialization progress.

Meanwhile, Oracle’s collaboration with NVIDIA is also expanding. Both parties said they will use NVIDIA’s latest Vera Rubin servers to lift Oracle Cloud’s deployment scale to a “multi‑gigawatt” level. No monetary terms were disclosed, but NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has suggested that each gigawatt of Vera Rubin deployment could generate up to $40 billion in revenue for NVIDIA—a revenue estimate, not the actual contract size with Oracle.

Oracle also plans to replace some NVIDIA networking products with its own Acceleron network chips in systems that use NVIDIA GPUs, showing the company’s intent to diversify chip suppliers while boosting its own data‑center networking autonomy. Oracle said the expanded infrastructure will support AI model training, inference and AI‑agent workloads, allowing customers to adjust CPU and GPU resources according to specific job requirements.

However, scaling data‑center capacity at such magnitude brings heavy capital‑expenditure and financing pressures. Oracle previously noted in earnings calls that customers are increasingly shouldering chip procurement costs themselves, and the company is maintaining a 2027 fiscal‑year capex target of roughly $90 billion to $95 billion. The market watches how Oracle will fund its data‑center expansion and whether the new investments will translate into revenue and cash flow in a timely manner.

Overall, Oracle’s simultaneous expansion of its NVIDIA partnership, introduction of Google TPUs and Cerebras inference chips is not merely a shift toward NVIDIA’s rivals but an effort to offer more flexible compute architectures for varied AI workloads. For Cerebras, the Oracle deal promises access to large cloud customers and revenue growth; for the broader AI‑infrastructure industry, it signals that competition is moving beyond single‑chip performance toward inference speed, cost efficiency, supply resilience and the overall scale of data‑center deployments.

items.title: 72%的Token消耗僅占27%支出？AI多空之爭的關鍵
items.title_en: 72% of Token Consumption Accounts for Only 27% of Spending? The Key to the AI Bull‑Bear Battle
paras: AI需求數據正在製造一場罕見的市場分歧：同組數字，多頭和空頭各取所需，雙方都宣稱勝利。這場爭論的核心是個令人不安的結構性矛盾——Token消耗量爆炸式增長，但絕大多數增量流向了收費最低的模型，而服務這些Token的GPU成本卻在同步攀升。
高盛Bobby Molavi在報告中披露，OpenRouter數據顯示，開源權重模型（open-weight models）在9月第二週處理了72%的Token流量，卻僅獲得平台總支出的27%；同時，閉源模型的支出占比雖然從1月初的89%降至73%，仍掌握絕大部分貨幣化收益。
更值得關注的是，OpenRouter平台9月中旬約69%的Token來自中國AI實驗室。Molavi將當前市場形容為「無法操作」（unplayable），並指出，AI生產力紅利迄今尚未在科技產業以外留下可量化的痕跡。
這項結構性矛盾正在重塑市場對AI投資回報的預期。 GPU租金持續上漲，Token售價持續下跌，兩端同時承壓，意味著算力供應商坐享租金紅利，而為此買單的企業客戶和最終股東，卻面臨投資報酬率（ROI）難以兌現的困境。Meta近期向股東募資最高950億美元，用於AI資本支出，其晶片供應商同步入股，標誌著「供應商融資」已從債務形式演變為股權形式，資本循環的可持續性疑問愈發迫切。
需求本身的增長無可置疑。 Molavi援引OpenRouter數據指出，Token需求自2025年11月以來增長了27倍，開源權重模型目前占據72%的Token份額。
從另一較長的觀察區間來看，OpenRouter平台每週Token處理量從2025年1月中旬的0.5兆枚，飆升至2026年9月14日當週的128.4兆枚，約20個月內增長257倍，亦即約250倍。這項數據與自2025年11月以來的27倍增幅，採用不同的起算時間，不能直接視為相互矛盾。
GPU定價同樣印證了需求的真實性。 H200租賃價格年內上漲160%，B200上漲120%，H100上漲35%。更具說服力的是，2020年出產的A100晶片，目前的租賃價格已高於年初水準。這直接衝擊了此前關於GPU折舊週期的核心假設——若一塊晶片在六年後仍能產生更高收益，那麼以三年為基準的悲觀折舊預測便值得重新檢視，超大規模雲端服務商的長期獲利潛力也需要重新評估。
對多頭而言，這是最有力的論據：需求是真實的，算力資產的經濟壽命可能比空頭預期的更長。
Token價格自由落體：史上最快通縮
然而，需求爆炸的另一面，是Token價格以前所未有的速度崩塌。據Epoch AI於9月22日發布的研究報告「思維價格的暴跌」（The Plunging Price of Thought），自2023年以來，達到同等AI性能水準的成本每季下降約47%，即每年降低約13倍；在前沿模型領域，降價速度更快，平均每季下降66%，即每年降低約75倍。
Epoch AI提出的案例是：2025年1月，OpenAI的o3模型在GPQA Diamond博士級科學題基準測試中答對75%，每題成本約0.30美元；原文指出，GPT-5.6 Luna達到同等分數，每題成本僅0.0004美元，18個月內價格下降725倍——相當於一輛標價5萬美元的汽車跌價至69美元。
從歷史橫向比較來看，大型語言模型推理價格的下降速度，是DNA定序的4倍、1940至2001年間計算能力提升速度的6倍、鋰離子電池的18倍，以及電力的54倍。
不過，客戶實際支付的價格下降遠慢於標價。YipitData追蹤的近2,000兆枚年化Token數據顯示，API服務的有效Token定價在2025年下半年下降39%（OpenRouter平台則下降44%）；截至2026年5月，2026年年初至今的降幅則為6%。這兩組數字涵蓋不同期間，因此不能直接比較為同一期間的降幅。
原因在於： 開發者持續追逐更便宜的模型，而企業客戶則增加高端模型的使用比例。前沿AI實驗室憑藉最新模型的溢價能力，暫時支撐了營收；但Epoch的數據表明，這種溢價的半衰期以季度計算，因為開源複製版本很快便能以極低成本完成同等任務。
誰在賺錢 誰在買單？
這正是Molavi所描述的「同一數據，兩種解讀」困境的核心所在。
多頭的邏輯是：需求持續擴大，可尋址市場（TAM）仍在增長，Token消耗量的爆炸式增長證明AI正在被廣泛採用。
空頭的邏輯則是：每Token成本在上升，每Token收入在下降，而增量流量的主體正是那些收費最低的開源模型。 OpenRouter數據清楚呈現了這一圖景：開源權重模型處理了72%的Token，卻只占27%的支出；中國AI實驗室貢獻了平台近七成的Token流量。高盛的momo basket恰好在6月底見頂，時間點與中國開源權重模型大規模湧入AI市場高度吻合。
Molavi將這項矛盾概括為：GPU租金上漲與Token售價下跌，是同一種擠壓從兩端呈現的結果。 對GPU持有者而言是利好；對支付租金的企業而言，則是另一番景象。
生產力紅利缺席：S&P 493的沉默
AI資本支出的終極邏輯，是透過生產力提升帶動全社會收益。但目前，這項邏輯尚未在科技產業以外獲得數據驗證。
Molavi援引一份策略師報告指出，AI「尚未在科技產業以外的關鍵數據中呈現出可量化的生產力提升」：七大科技巨頭的人均營收和利潤率均有所提升，但S&P 493（標普500指數中其餘493家公司）的對應指標幾乎持平。
這項現實正在改變企業界的AI決策邏輯。 Molavi觀察到，大量企業正從「Token支出與增長和生產力的相關性」，轉向審視「Token支出對成本及利潤率的影響」。財務長們已經找到AI這項預算支出，他們想知道花出去的錢究竟買到了什麼。
「繁榮循環」與資本可持續性
支撐當前AI資本支出狂潮的，是Molavi所描述的一個「繁榮循環」：超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出越多，流入AI生態系的收入就越多，進而吸引風險資本和成長股權資本湧入，形成雙向資金流——而這一切的錨點，就是最初的AI資本支出本身。
這個循環的致命弱點，在於其可持續性：一旦資本支出放緩，整個生態系的收入能否自我維持？
私募市場同樣未能免疫。 Molavi指出，當前的退出案例「數量可觀但極度集中」，包括SpaceX、Cerebras、Cursor及Hugging Face；部分項目的估值重估「除了一份投資意向書之外，沒有任何催化劑」，整個私募市場的交易邏輯「彷彿Token時代永不落幕、萬物皆將被顛覆」。
在融資端，隨著債務融資管道收窄，Meta近期宣布向股東募資最高950億美元，用於AI資本支出，其晶片供應商也同步參與入股。供應商融資已從債務形式演變為股權形式，資金提供者與使用者之間的收入及融資界線日益模糊。
Molavi將整場辯論的本質歸結為四個問題：建設成本有多高、誰來買單、付出的代價是否值得，以及需要等待多久才能看到收入回報。
當前的數據格局是：從2025年1月至2026年9月，OpenRouter每週Token處理量增長約250倍，但開源權重模型處理的Token占72%，僅占27%的平台支出；GPU租金上漲，但帳單最終由支付算力費用的企業承擔，並可能影響股東回報；生產力紅利在科技產業以外尚無可量化的明確跡象。
Molavi的結論是，需求的真實性無可置疑，但「需求增長250倍，資金流向最廉價的模型、租金流向GPU持有者、帳單轉嫁給股東」，並不是當初資本支出所承諾的投資報酬率（ROI）故事。 在這場多空拔河中，空頭或許握有更有力的那半段繩子。
paras_en: AI demand data is creating a rare market split: within the same numbers, bulls and bears each take what they need, both claiming victory. The core of the debate is an unsettling structural contradiction—token consumption is exploding, yet the vast majority of the incremental flow goes to the lowest‑priced models, while the GPU cost to serve those tokens is rising in tandem.

Goldman Sachs’ Bobby Molavi disclosed in a report that OpenRouter data shows open‑weight models handled 72% of token traffic in the second week of September but received only 27% of the platform’s total spend; at the same time, spending on closed‑source models fell from 89% at the start of January to 73%, still capturing the bulk of monetized revenue.

More noteworthy, about 69% of September‑mid tokens on OpenRouter came from Chinese AI labs. Molavi described the current market as “unplayable” and noted that AI productivity gains have yet to leave a quantifiable trace outside the tech sector.

This structural contradiction is reshaping market expectations for AI investment returns. GPU rental rates keep climbing while token prices keep falling, pressuring both ends: compute providers enjoy rental premiums, but the enterprise customers and ultimate shareholders paying the bills face ROI challenges. Meta recently raised up to $95 billion from shareholders for AI capex, with its chip suppliers taking equity stakes, signaling that “supplier financing” has shifted from debt to equity and raising doubts about the sustainability of the capital cycle.
The growth in demand itself is undeniable. Molavi cited OpenRouter data showing token demand has risen 27‑fold since November 2025, with open‑weight models now holding a 72% token share.

Looking at a longer window, OpenRouter’s weekly token volume jumped from 0.5 trillion in mid‑January 2025 to 128.4 trillion in the week of September 14 2026 – a 257‑fold increase over about 20 months, roughly 250‑fold. This figure, based on a different start date than the 27‑fold rise since November 2025, is not directly contradictory.

GPU pricing also confirms the reality of demand. H200 lease prices rose 160% year‑to‑date, B200 120%, H100 35%. More striking, the 2020‑era A100 chip now rents above early‑year levels. This directly challenges the core assumption about GPU depreciation cycles – if a chip can generate higher returns after six years, the pessimistic three‑year depreciation model needs revisiting, and the long‑term profit potential of hyperscale cloud providers must be reassessed.
For bulls, this is the strongest argument: demand is real, and the economic life of compute assets may be longer than bears anticipate.
Token prices in free‑fall: the fastest deflation in history

However, the flip side of exploding demand is that token prices are collapsing at an unprecedented pace. According to Epoch AI’s September 22 research report “The Plunging Price of Thought,” since 2023 the cost to achieve comparable AI performance has dropped about 47% each quarter – roughly a 13‑fold annual decline; in frontier models the drop is even faster, averaging a 66% quarterly decline – about a 75‑fold annual reduction.

Epoch AI’s case study: in January 2025 OpenAI’s o3 model scored 75% on the GPQA Diamond PhD‑level science benchmark at a cost of about $0.30 per question; the report notes GPT‑5.6 Luna achieved the same score at $0.0004 per question, a 725‑fold price drop in 18 months – comparable to a $50,000 car falling to $69.

Historically, the speed of LLM inference price decline is four times faster than DNA sequencing, six times faster than the compute growth from 1940‑2001, 18 times faster than lithium‑ion battery cost reductions, and 54 times faster than electricity price declines.

Nevertheless, the price paid by customers falls far slower than list prices. YipitData’s tracking of nearly 2,000 trillion annualized tokens shows effective API token pricing fell 39% in the second half of 2025 (OpenRouter fell 44%); by May 2026 the year‑to‑date decline was 6%. These figures cover different periods and cannot be directly compared as the same interval.

The reason: developers keep chasing cheaper models, while enterprise customers increase their share of high‑end models. Frontier AI labs, leveraging premium pricing of the latest models, temporarily sustain revenue; but Epoch’s data shows that such premium’s half‑life is measured in quarters, as open‑source replicas quickly achieve the same tasks at minimal cost.
Who is making money and who is paying the bill?
This is exactly the core of the “same data, two interpretations” dilemma Molavi describes.
Bull logic: demand keeps expanding, the total addressable market (TAM) keeps growing, and the explosive token consumption proves AI is being widely adopted.

Bear logic: per‑token cost is rising, per‑token revenue is falling, and the incremental flow is dominated by the cheapest open‑source models. OpenRouter data clearly shows this picture: open‑weight models process 72% of tokens but only account for 27% of spend; Chinese AI labs contribute nearly 70% of platform token flow. Goldman’s momo basket peaked at the end of June, coinciding with the massive influx of Chinese open‑weight models into the AI market.

Molavi sums up the contradiction: rising GPU rents and falling token prices are two sides of the same squeeze. It’s a boon for GPU owners; for the enterprises paying the rents, it’s a different story.
Productivity dividend absent: the silence of the S&P 493
The ultimate logic of AI capex is to drive societal gains through productivity gains. So far, that logic has not been validated outside the tech sector.

Molavi cites a strategist report stating AI “has not yet shown quantifiable productivity gains in key data outside the tech industry”: the seven major tech giants have seen per‑employee revenue and profit margin improvements, but the corresponding metrics for the S&P 493 (the other 493 S&P 500 companies) are essentially flat.

This reality is reshaping corporate AI decision‑making. Molavi notes many firms are shifting from linking “token spend to growth and productivity” to examining “token spend’s impact on cost and profit margins.” CFOs have found the AI budget line and now want to know exactly what the spend buys.
“Prosperity cycle” and capital sustainability

What fuels the current AI capex frenzy is what Molavi calls a “prosperity cycle”: the more hyperscale cloud providers spend, the more revenue flows into the AI ecosystem, attracting venture and growth‑equity capital, creating a two‑way money flow – all anchored by the initial AI capex itself.
The fatal weakness of this cycle is its sustainability: if capex slows, can the ecosystem’s revenue sustain itself?

The private‑equity market is no exception. Molavi points out that current exit cases are “numerous but highly concentrated,” including SpaceX, Cerebras, Cursor and Hugging Face; some valuations are being re‑rated “with no catalyst beyond a term sheet,” and the whole private market’s logic “seems to assume the token era will never end and everything will be disrupted.”

On the financing side, as debt channels narrow, Meta recently announced a $95 billion shareholder raise for AI capex, with its chip suppliers also taking equity stakes. Supplier financing has shifted from debt to equity, blurring the line between capital providers and users.
Molavi distills the debate into four questions: how high are construction costs, who will foot the bill, is the price worth paying, and how long must one wait to see revenue return.

Current data landscape: from January 2025 to September 2026 OpenRouter’s weekly token volume grew about 250‑fold, open‑weight models handled 72% of tokens but only 27% of platform spend; GPU rents are up while the bill ultimately falls on the enterprises paying for compute, potentially affecting shareholder returns; and there is no quantifiable productivity dividend outside the tech sector.

Molavi concludes that while demand’s reality is indisputable, “250‑fold demand growth, capital flowing to the cheapest models, rent flowing to GPU owners, and the bill shifting to shareholders” does not match the ROI story promised by the original capex. In this bull‑bear tug‑of‑war, bears may be holding the stronger half of the rope.

items.title_en: U.S. Plans Further Release of Russian Diesel, Using a “Carrot” to Promote a Ceasefire, Analyst Says It Won’t Significantly Lower Oil Prices
paras: 美國能源部長萊特（Chris Wright）接受《CNBC》專訪時表示，美國可能視俄羅斯的行動，允許更多俄國柴油進入全球市場。
萊特周二(27日)表示，川普政府本月稍早暫停對俄羅斯柴油出口的制裁，是為了提供「誘因」，促使莫斯科結束烏克蘭戰爭。他說，此舉將有助於小幅增加燃料供應。
根據船舶追蹤平台 MarineTraffic 的數據，懸掛俄國國旗的油輪「Talisman 號」預計於 11 月 9 日抵達美國東岸；另一艘油輪「Leruo 號」則已離開俄國航向「大西洋海岸」，但尚未明確申報目的地是否為美國。
萊特坦言，在美國豁免制裁的政策下，「很有可能」會有更多裝載俄柴油的油輪啟航，並強調這項舉措意在向俄國「抛出蘿蔔」。
這項協議源於總統川普與俄國總統普丁達成的共識，俄方將在 10 月與 11 月先向外出口 80 萬公噸柴油，隨後再追加 100 萬公噸。
面對下週二(11月3日)即將到來的美國期中選舉，川普因美以兩國於 2 月 28 日襲擊伊朗後飆漲的燃料價格而承受巨大的政治壓力，因而促成了此項交易。
不過市場分析師指出，該交易的柴油供給量並無法實質壓低油價，因為相較於全球每日約 2,800 萬桶的總需求量，這批出貨規模仍屬微不足道。
俄國首批 30 萬公噸的貨量若分一個月釋出，約相當於每日 7.5 萬桶；第二批 50 萬公噸則約折合每日 12.4 萬桶。
烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基強烈批評這項柴油協議。烏克蘭今年持續猛攻俄羅斯煉油廠，試圖削減克里姆林宮的能源出口收入，並削弱俄羅斯持續作戰的能力。
這些攻擊迫使俄羅斯於 7 月實施柴油出口禁令。為履行川普與普丁達成的協議，克里姆林宮已局部解除禁令。
數名共和黨參議員也猛烈抨擊這項協議，並與民主黨同僚聯名致函，譴責協議是「送給對手的大禮，也是對盟友的背叛」
paras_en: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that the United States may, depending on Russia’s actions, allow more Russian diesel to enter the global market.

Wright said on Tuesday the Trump administration’s brief suspension earlier this month of sanctions on Russian diesel exports was intended as an “incentive” to get Moscow to end the war in Ukraine, and that the move would modestly increase fuel supplies.

According to vessel‑tracking platform MarineTraffic, the Russian‑flagged tanker “Talisman” is expected to arrive on the U.S. East Coast on November 9, while another tanker, “Leruo,” has left Russia heading for the “Atlantic coast,” though its exact destination has not been confirmed as the United States.

Wright admitted that under a U.S. sanctions‑waiver policy “it is very likely” that more tankers carrying Russian diesel will set sail, emphasizing that the step is meant to “throw a carrot” to Russia.

The deal stems from a consensus reached between President Trump and Russian President Putin, under which Russia will export 800,000 metric tons of diesel abroad in October and November, followed by an additional 1 million metric tons.

Facing the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday, November 3, Trump is under intense political pressure over soaring fuel prices that followed the February 28 attack on Iran by the United States and Israel, which helped push this deal through.

However, market analysts note that the volume of diesel in the deal cannot materially depress oil prices, because the shipment size is negligible compared with the world’s daily demand of roughly 28 million barrels.

If Russia’s first batch of 300,000 metric tons is released over a month, it equates to about 75,000 barrels per day; the second batch of 500,000 metric tons works out to roughly 124,000 barrels per day.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sharply criticized the diesel agreement, noting that Ukraine has been intensively striking Russian refineries this year to cut Kremlin energy‑export revenues and weaken Russia’s ability to sustain its war effort.
Those attacks forced Russia to impose a diesel export ban in July. To honor the Trump‑Putin agreement, the Kremlin has partially lifted the ban.
Several Republican senators also fiercely attacked the deal, joining Democratic colleagues in a joint letter condemning the agreement as “a big gift to the opponent and a betrayal of our allies.”

【SK海力士獲利暴增632%！】記憶體、AI伺服器、先進製程誰最受惠？

paras_en: [1] Japan and South Korea’s stock markets rally across the board! SK Hynix’s profit surges 632%, signaling a genuine AI bull comeback?

[2] Last night all four major U.S. indices closed higher: the Dow rose 16 points, the S&P 500 up 0.60%, the Nasdaq up 1.18%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 3.60%. TSMC ADR gained 2.95%! Notably, Japan and South Korea continued their morning gains this morning—Japan’s Nikkei up about 1.3% and Korea’s KOSPI up roughly 2.2%—showing Asian semiconductor buying pressure returning. The latest big catalyst is SK Hynix’s Q3 results: revenue of 104.6 trillion won, up 328% YoY, and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, up 632% YoY, with an operating margin of 80%. The company also said that more than 50% of its capacity for 2027‑2028 is already secured through long‑term contracts, indicating AI‑driven demand for HBM and high‑end memory is translating into real sales and profit, not just speculation. Meanwhile, a cooling in U.S.–Iran diplomatic talks has pushed Brent crude back toward $110, easing inflation pressure. However, U.S. Dow and Nasdaq futures this morning were only marginally higher, suggesting the market is still waiting for the Fed’s rate decision. Technically, the S&P 500 has retaken the 7,700‑point level, with short‑term resistance near 7,800; the semiconductor index is testing 11,500, and a clean break would support further tech rebounds.
[3] Taiwan Futures Night Session Soars 774 Points! Can the Taiwan market reclaim the 47,000‑point mark?

[4] Taiwan stocks experienced wild swings yesterday. The market surged 544 points in the early session, then slumped 909 points from the high, ending up only 55 points higher at 46,096, indicating heavy selling pressure at the upper end. Yet the night session futures jumped 774 points to close at 46,880, with TSMC futures up 2.95%, ASE Technology ADR up 5.3%, and UMC ADR up 1.4%. All related ADRs rose, and Japan and Korea also closed higher. Especially before the Fed’s rate announcement, the market showed a clear reversal, suggesting the selling wave is largely over. Strong fundamentals, such as SK Hynix’s 632% profit surge, keep proving that global AI demand remains robust and semiconductor sentiment hasn’t collapsed with the stock price. As discussed on yesterday’s show, if Taiwan’s market and TSMC can hold above the seasonal line today, it could be a good entry point—but with the Fed meeting looming, it’s still wise to stagger purchases rather than go all‑in at once.
[5] SK Hynix’s Profit Jumps 632%! Which segments—memory, AI servers, advanced processes—benefit the most?

[6] Regarding individual stocks, I focus on three main themes today. First, the memory sector. SK Hynix reported Q3 revenue up 328% YoY and operating profit up 632% YoY, and expects HBM4 to become mainstream from Q4, with contracts covering more than half of its 2027‑2028 capacity, confirming tight supply‑demand for high‑end memory. Taiwan’s Nanya (2408‑TW), Winbond (2344‑TW) and Phison (8299‑TW) are worth watching, but remember HBM’s product mix differs from standard DRAM and NAND, so SK Hynix’s margins can’t be directly applied; we need to verify local pricing and profitability. Second, AI servers and ASIC chips. Anthropic’s IPO and a roughly $40 billion AI‑equipment financing lease commitment from SpaceX and Apollo‑related entities show large tech firms are still expanding compute power, supporting long‑term AI hardware demand. Keep an eye on TSMC (2330‑TW), Creative (3443‑TW), SiTime‑KY (3661‑TW), Wi‑Yen (6669‑TW), Quanta (2382‑TW) and Foxconn (2317‑TW), though financing deals don’t guarantee firm orders. Third, high‑end PCBs and thermal solutions. As AI workloads grow, demand for high‑speed, low‑loss materials and high‑power cooling rises. Companies such as Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383‑TW), Tai Yao (6274‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Golden Eagle (2368‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW) and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) could benefit.

[7] Remember, SK Hynix’s earnings today reaffirm that AI demand hasn’t vanished, but spotting a trend doesn’t mean you can buy any stock indiscriminately. Stick to long positions, allocate gradually to truly revenue‑generating, profitable companies with solid orders—timing the purchase is more important than merely predicting the market direction!

items.title: 傳Anthropic考慮向散戶提供15-20%的IPO股份 小摩將牽頭美散戶配售事宜
items.title_en: Anthropic Considers Offering 15‑20% of IPO Shares to Retail Investors, JPMorgan to Lead US Retail Allocation
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，Anthropic已選定摩根大通(下稱小摩)負責其IPO面向美國散戶的股票銷售，摩根大通執行長戴蒙預計將參與該行的IPO活動。小摩此前曾在SpaceX規模達862億美元的IPO中牽頭組織散戶認購，此次將在Anthropic IPO中再次承擔此角色。
《彭博資訊》周三(28日)引述知情人士消息報導，Anthropic已考慮將IPO整體可供發售股份的約15%至20%分配給散戶。
知情人士也透露，花旗將負責協調面向國際散戶投資者的發售。
晨星(Morningstar)歐洲股票首席策略師Michael Field表示，Anthropic上市估值預計將介在1.5兆至2兆美元之間，與SpaceX大致相同，IPO時間表似乎定於美國期中選舉之後，可避免被選舉相關政治新聞掩蓋，並可受惠於更清晰的政策大方向，目前對Meta及Alphabet等多家受AI主題帶動的公司仍持正面看法。
Field指出，AI股票表現一直波動，市場對CoreWeave等AI基建供應商尤其嚴苛，預期到Anthropic上市時，市場將可更清楚掌握AI行業整體表現。
Field也對Anthropic招股文件中的企業治理部分表示關注，指出該公司治理架構似乎旨在限制股東影響董事會組成，或促成收購的能力。
文件中也顯示，Anthropic此次發行也將在澳洲、加拿大、日本、部分歐洲經濟區國家、瑞士和英國進行。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Anthropic has selected JPMorgan (referred to as “JPM”) to handle the retail‑investor portion of its IPO in the United States, and JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon is expected to take part in the bank’s IPO activities. JPM previously led the retail allocation for SpaceX’s $86.2 billion IPO and will assume the same role for Anthropic’s offering.
Bloomberg Intelligence quoted sources on Wednesday (the 28th) saying Anthropic is considering allocating roughly 15% to 20% of the total shares offered in the IPO to retail investors.
Sources also said Citi will be responsible for coordinating the sale to international retail investors.

Morningstar’s European equities chief strategist Michael Field said Anthropic’s valuation is expected to fall between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion, roughly comparable to SpaceX, and that the IPO timeline appears set for after the U.S. mid‑term elections to avoid being eclipsed by election‑related news and to benefit from a clearer policy outlook. He remains positive on AI‑themed stocks such as Meta and Alphabet.

Field noted that AI stocks have been volatile and that the market has been especially harsh on AI infrastructure providers like CoreWeave, but expects that by the time Anthropic goes public the market will have a clearer view of the AI sector’s overall performance.

Field also expressed concerns about the corporate‑governance section of Anthropic’s prospectus, pointing out that the company’s governance structure seems designed to limit shareholder influence over board composition or the ability to pursue acquisitions.
The filing shows that Anthropic’s offering will also be conducted in Australia, Canada, Japan, several European Economic Area countries, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉敬鵬獲工控新訂單挹注營收 股價順勢大漲攻漲停鎖死54.5元
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Jingpeng Boosted by New Industrial Control Order, Shares Surge to Upper Limit at NT$54.5
paras: 敬鵬(2355-TW)獲工控電子板新訂單挹注，9月營收攀升至18.71億元，也改寫102個月新高，激勵今(28)日股價早盤量能充沛並順勢大漲9.99%，攻漲停價54.5元。法人看好，敬鵬2026年整體營運可望較去年回升，隨著泰國新廠產能陸續加入，加上公司多年深耕泰國PCB市場、累積成熟的生產經驗，敬鵬在2027年成長動能也備受關注。
在全球車廠需求維持穩定下，敬鵬2026年上半年營收達97.7億元，年增6.17%，其中汽車板出貨占比升至77%，高於2025年平均的75%；此外，包含航太、低軌衛星(LEO)板等應用的網通板，出貨占比也維持在約5%。法人預期，隨著汽車板需求穩健，加上泰國新產能挹注，敬鵬2026年營運可望優於去年，2027年成長表現更值得期待。
汽車板市場需求回溫有利敬鵬營收、敬鵬並跨足工業控制電子板逐漸有成，工業電子控制板在今年取得新訂單，業績預估將由今年下半年起走高，同時，敬鵬除在泰國生產基地原廠完成改造投產之外，新建生產大樓的新投資進展順利，預計2027年還有新產能投產，且目前對 CCL成本節節上攀的營運干擾，並已陸續向客戶端反映。
paras_en: Jingpeng (2355-TW) received a new order for industrial control electronic boards, lifting September revenue to NT$1.871 billion—a 102‑month high. The news spurred strong early‑session buying, pushing the stock up 9.99% to the daily limit price of NT$54.5. Institutional investors are optimistic, expecting Jingpeng’s overall 2026 operations to improve over last year. With capacity from a new Thai plant coming online and the company’s long‑standing foothold and mature production experience in Thailand’s PCB market, Jingpeng’s growth momentum in 2027 is also drawing attention.

Jingpeng’s September 2026 revenue reached NT$1.871 billion, up 27.36% month‑over‑month and 44.28% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue was NT$4.812 billion, up 13.45% sequentially and 24.7% annually; cumulative revenue for January‑September this year totaled NT$13.108 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 11.19%.

With global automakers maintaining stable demand, Jingpeng’s first‑half‑2026 revenue hit NT$9.77 billion, a 6.17% year‑over‑year rise, of which automotive board shipments accounted for 77%, higher than the 75% average in 2025. Additionally, network‑communication boards for aerospace, low‑Earth‑orbit (LEO) satellite and other applications remained at about 5% of shipments. Institutions expect that solid automotive board demand, combined with new capacity in Thailand, will enable Jingpeng’s 2026 performance to surpass last year, and its 2027 growth outlook looks even more promising.

The rebound in automotive board demand benefits Jingpeng’s revenue, and its foray into industrial control electronic boards is gaining traction. New orders for industrial electronic control boards were secured this year, with earnings expected to rise from the second half onward. Moreover, beyond completing the renovation and commissioning of its original Thai production base, the construction of a new manufacturing building is progressing smoothly, with additional capacity slated to come online in 2027. The company is also addressing rising CCL costs, which have been causing operational disruptions, by communicating the issue to its customers.

items.title: 光寶科(2301)第三季營收創39季新高！800VDC時程提前，2027年才是真正的放量年？
items.title_en: Opto22 (2301) Q3 Revenue Hits 39th-Quarter Record! 800VDC Timeline Accelerated, 2027 Is the Real Volume Year?
paras: 2026年10月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光寶科(2301) AI電源成長動能持續升溫，第三季營收達574.46億元，季增9%、年增28%，創39季新高。
AI相關營收占比從2025年的約20%，提升至2026年第二季的25%以上，全年目標朝30%邁進。
更值得關注的是，800VDC高壓直流電源架構進度提前，搭配美國德州與高雄擴產，光寶科正加速搶攻AI資料中心電源商機。
不過，資本支出持續增加，後續仍須觀察新產能利用率與毛利率能否跟上。

AI營收占比挑戰30%，電源規格升級推升單機價值
光寶科AI相關營收占比持續提高，2025年約20%，2026年第二季已突破25%，公司維持全年超過30%的目標。
除了出貨量增加，電源規格升級也是重要成長動能。
從產品規格來看，電源供應器（PSU）正由過去3至5kW，提升至8kW，下一代更朝18.3kW發展；Power Shelf則從33kW推進至110kW。
隨著AI伺服器運算功耗提高，電源系統的功率與整合需求同步增加，有助於提升單機價值，成為光寶科AI營收成長的重要推力。

800VDC進度提前，2027年進入關鍵放量期
光寶科800VDC布局進度出現變化。
公司2026年2月原先預估，樣機於第三季完成測試、第四季小量出貨，並在2027年第一季大規模量產；截至10月，ASIC客戶已提前於8月完成驗證，預計11月小量出貨，較原先規劃提前一至兩季。
在既有產品方面，50V、500kW Power Rack已於2026年第二季放量，800V、1.5MW機櫃專案則進入驗證階段。
MW級Power Rack可整合6組220kW Power Shelf，總裝置容量達1.32MW，反映資料中心電源系統正朝更高功率發展。
市場也開始關注800VDC的長期滲透率。
巴克萊預估，800VDC架構將於2027年底擴大導入，2029年占新增資料中心裝置容量約30%。
不過，從客戶驗證、小量出貨到大規模量產仍有一段距離，2027年能否如期放量，將是觀察光寶科AI電源成長的重要指標。

資本支出持續加碼，德州與高雄擴產同步推進
為了因應AI電源需求，光寶科持續提高投資規模。
2026年初法人估計資本支出約77億元，4月上修至130億元，7月底再提高至180億元；此後，公司又宣布德州麥金尼新廠投資約9.19億美元，高雄擴產計畫也加碼約88.5億元。
海外產能方面，高雄二期預計2026年第三季投產，越南廣寧廠預計第四季投產，德州麥金尼新廠則規劃於2027年上半年量產高壓直流電源與BBU。
公司也積極提高非中國產能占比，目標在2026年底超過60%，2027年進一步提升至70%。
擴產有助於拉高供應能力、貼近客戶需求，但資本支出增加也代表未來折舊與營運成本將隨產能開出逐步反映。
後續除了追蹤新廠投產時程，也要留意產能利用率與訂單成長是否足以支撐新增投資。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

毛利率以24.7%為合理基準，成本壓力仍不可忽視
光寶科管理層指出，2026年上半年24.7%的毛利率，才是較合理的觀察基準，長期目標則為25%，不代表每季都能維持27%的水準。
隨著AI電源占比提升與產品規格升級，產品組合有機會改善，但仍須觀察實際出貨結構與成本變化。
此外，記憶體、處理器等零組件價格上漲及缺料問題，可能壓縮非AI產品的獲利空間。
當公司同時擴大資本支出、推進新世代電源產品，投資人除了關注營收是否持續創高，也應同步檢視毛利率、折舊費用及自由現金流的變化。
整體而言，光寶科正從AI電源需求成長，進一步受惠於高功率規格升級與800VDC架構導入。
2026年營收動能已經轉強，2027年的關鍵則在於800VDC能否順利放量，以及德州、高雄等新增產能能否轉化為實際營收與獲利。
若訂單、產能與毛利率同步改善，AI電源有望成為公司下一階段的重要成長引擎。

paras_en: On October 28, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Opto22 (2301) AI power growth momentum continues to heat up, with Q3 revenue reaching 57.446 billion NTD, up 9% from the prior quarter and 28% from the year‑ago, setting a new 39‑quarter high.
AI‑related revenue accounted for about 20% in 2025, rising to over 25% in Q2 2026, with the annual target moving toward 30%.

More noteworthy is the accelerated progress of the 800 VDC high‑voltage DC power supply architecture, coupled with expansion in Texas, USA, and Kaohsiung, Taiwan, as Opto22 speeds up its capture of AI data‑center power opportunities.
However, capital expenditures continue to rise, and it remains to be seen whether new capacity utilization and gross margin can keep pace.

AI revenue share challenges 30%, power supply specification upgrades lift unit value – Opto22’s AI‑related revenue share continues to rise, about 20% in 2025, breaking 25% in Q2 2026, with the company maintaining a goal of over 30% for the year.
In addition to increased shipment volume, power supply specification upgrades are also an important growth driver.

From a product specification perspective, power supply units (PSUs) are moving from the past 3–5 kW to 8 kW, with the next generation heading toward 18.3 kW; Power Shelves are advancing from 33 kW to 110 kW.

As AI server compute power consumption rises, the power and integration demands of power systems increase in tandem, helping to raise unit value and becoming a key driver of Opto22’s AI revenue growth.
800 VDC progress accelerated, 2027 enters critical volume phase – Opto22’s 800 VDC layout progress has changed.

In February 2026, the company originally estimated that prototypes would complete testing in Q3, small‑scale shipments in Q4, and large‑scale mass production in Q1 2027; as of October, ASIC customers had completed verification in August, with small‑scale shipments expected in November, one to two quarters ahead of the original plan.
In existing products, the 50 V, 500 kW Power Rack was ramped up in Q2 2026, while the 800 V, 1.5 MW cabinet project entered the verification stage.
MW‑class Power Racks can integrate six 220 kW Power Shelves, with a total device capacity of 1.32 MW, reflecting data‑center power systems moving toward higher power.
The market is also beginning to focus on the long‑term penetration of 800 VDC.
Barclays estimates that the 800 VDC architecture will expand by the end of 2027, accounting for about 30% of new data‑center device capacity in 2029.

However, from customer verification, small‑scale shipment to large‑scale mass production remains a distance; whether 2027 can meet volume expectations will be an important indicator of Opto22’s AI power growth.
Capital expenditures continue to increase, with Texas and Kaohsiung expansions proceeding in tandem – To meet AI power demand, Opto22 continues to raise investment scale.

At the beginning of 2026, the company estimated capital expenditures at about 7.7 billion NTD, raised to 13 billion in April, and to 18 billion by the end of July; thereafter, the company announced a new Texas McKinney plant investment of about 919 million USD, and the Kaohsiung expansion plan added about 8.85 billion NTD.

In overseas capacity, Kaohsiung Phase II is expected to start production in Q3 2026, the Vietnam Gwangning plant in Q4 2026, and the Texas McKinney new plant is planned to start mass production of high‑voltage DC power supplies and BBU in H1 2027.
The company is also actively increasing non‑China capacity share, aiming to exceed 60% by the end of 2026 and further to 70% in 2027.
Expansions help raise supply capacity and meet customer needs, but increased capital expenditures also mean future depreciation and operating costs will gradually reflect as capacity is deployed.
In the future, besides tracking new plant production schedules, it is also important to monitor whether capacity utilization and order growth can support the new investment.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

Gross margin at 24.7% is a reasonable baseline; cost pressure remains significant – Opto22’s management pointed out that a 24.7% gross margin in H1 2026 is a more reasonable observation baseline, with a long‑term target of 25%, not every quarter maintaining a 27% level.
With AI power share rising and product specification upgrades, the product mix may improve, but actual shipment structure and cost changes must still be observed.
Additionally, rising prices and shortages of components such as memory and processors may compress the profitability of non‑AI products.

When the company simultaneously expands capital expenditures and pushes new‑generation power products, investors should not only focus on whether revenue continues to rise, but also simultaneously examine changes in gross margin, depreciation expenses, and free cash flow.
Overall, Opto22 is benefiting from AI power demand growth, further aided by high‑power specification upgrades and 800 VDC architecture adoption.

The momentum of 2026 revenue has already strengthened; the key for 2027 lies in whether 800 VDC can smoothly ramp up volume, and whether new capacity in Texas, Kaohsiung, and others can translate into actual revenue and profitability.
If orders, capacity, and gross margin improve together, AI power is expected to become the next major growth engine for the company.

[2] Last night all four major U.S. indices closed higher: the Dow rose 16 points, the S&P 500 up 0.60%, the Nasdaq up 1.18%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 3.60%. TSMC ADR gained 2.95%! The latest big catalyst is SK Hynix’s Q3 results: revenue of 104.6 trillion won, up 328% YoY, and operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, up 632% YoY, with an operating margin of 80%. The company also said that more than 50% of its capacity for 2027‑2028 is already secured through long‑term contracts, indicating AI‑driven demand for HBM and high‑end memory is translating into real sales and profit, not just speculation. Meanwhile, a cooling in U.S.–Iran diplomatic talks has pushed Brent crude back toward $110, easing inflation pressure. However, U.S. Dow and Nasdaq futures this morning were only marginally higher, suggesting the market is still waiting for the Fed’s rate decision. Technically, the S&P 500 has retaken the 7,700‑point level, with short‑term resistance near 7,800; the semiconductor index is testing 11,500, and a clean break would support further tech rebounds.
[3] Taiwan Futures Night Session Soars 774 Points! Can the Taiwan market reclaim the 47,000‑point mark?

[4] Taiwan stocks experienced wild swings yesterday. The market surged 544 points in the early session, then slumped 909 points from the high, ending up only 55 points higher at 46,096, indicating heavy selling pressure at the upper end. Yet the night session futures jumped 774 points to close at 46,880, with TSMC futures up 2.95%, ASE Technology ADR up 5.3%, and UMC ADR up 1.4%. All related ADRs rose, and Japan and Korea also closed higher. Especially before the Fed’s rate announcement, the market showed a clear reversal, suggesting the selling wave is largely over. Strong fundamentals, such as SK Hynix’s 632% profit surge, keep proving that global AI demand remains robust and semiconductor sentiment hasn’t collapsed with the stock price. As discussed on yesterday’s show, if Taiwan’s market and TSMC can hold above the seasonal line today, it could be a good entry point—but with the Fed meeting looming, it’s still wise to stagger purchases rather than go all‑in at once.
[5] SK Hynix’s Profit Jumps 632%! Which segments—memory, AI servers, advanced processes—benefit the most?

SK Hynix reported Q3 revenue up 328% YoY and operating profit up 632% YoY, and expects HBM4 to become mainstream from Q4, with contracts covering more than half of its 2027‑2028 capacity, confirming tight supply‑demand for high‑end memory. Taiwan’s Nanya (2408‑TW), Winbond (2344‑TW) and Phison (8299‑TW) are worth watching, but remember HBM’s product mix differs from standard DRAM and NAND, so SK Hynix’s margins can’t be directly applied; we need to verify local pricing and profitability. Second, AI servers and ASIC chips. Anthropic’s IPO and a roughly $40 billion AI‑equipment financing lease commitment from SpaceX and Apollo‑related entities show large tech firms are still expanding compute power, supporting long‑term AI hardware demand. Keep an eye on TSMC (2330‑TW), Creative (3443‑TW), SiTime‑KY (3661‑TW), Wi‑Yen (6669‑TW), Quanta (2382‑TW) and Foxconn (2317‑TW), though financing deals don’t guarantee firm orders. Third, high‑end PCBs and thermal solutions. As AI workloads grow, demand for high‑speed, low‑loss materials and high‑power cooling rises. Companies such as Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383‑TW), Tai Yao (6274‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Golden Eagle (2368‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW) and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) could benefit.

拆穿假利空：籌碼面洩漏的真實劇本
你以為外資最近大賣超就是看空台股、台股就會轉空了嗎？太單純了！看看期貨部位！外資雖佈空單，但前五大外資期貨交易人的多單口數依然穩穩在相對高檔；加上回顧歷史數據，台股過去遭遇外資大賣超的日子，如果你因為恐慌跟著砍在阿呆谷，隔天往往追不回來；而且只要拉長時間到 60 天後，上漲的勝率極高。
「下跌時沒有小麥，上漲時也沒有」！歷史經驗告訴我們，當大家都把籌碼拋售時，懂得在雨天抱緊績優股的人，等太陽一出來，才是最後大豐收的贏家。而我們的國家隊與八大官股早就在默默在下方接籌碼了。
AI 不是泡沫，而是正在爆發的生產力革命
再看基本面：最近很有人會擔心：「科技巨頭砸那麼多錢，回得了本嗎？」看看最新公布的資本支出，各大巨頭非但沒有縮手，反而在生成式 AI 與推論應用上持續加碼。以前的 AI 像是花錢「培養員工」，現在的 AI 則是讓訓練好的員工「24 小時不間斷幫企業賺錢」。從全球雲端服務商瘋狂擴建資料中心來看，這場生產力革命才正要進入使用量爆發期！
再回頭看台灣的經濟底氣，9月外銷訂單持續展現韌性，接下來上市櫃公司的營收表現絕對會端出驚喜。10月台股這波拉回，根本是上天給我們的「雙11大特價」！
第四季大軋空？ 8檔AI指標熱門股一次看
所以，面對10月這波回檔洗盤，千萬別跟著恐慌殺低，而是要在趁拉回時分批承接。以下這8 檔貫穿 AI 生產力革命與產業復甦的關鍵指標股，正是資金點火、多頭反攻的核心指標：
台積電(2330-TW)：先進製程與 CoWoS 封裝技術全球獨霸，身為全球雲端巨頭資本支出的最大受益者，營收與獲利持續挑戰新高，是台股最穩固的大盤基石。
聯發科(2454-TW)：手機晶片市佔穩健，並在旗艦晶片與車用、ASIC 領域多箭齊發，受惠高階智慧機換機潮與 AI 邊緣運算商機，獲利動能強勁。
